actual_request.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate exactly ONE full original 1024x1024 or larger SQUARE walking sprite of 10_crimson_spear_girl on genuine transparent alpha. No sheet, montage, inset, labels, background, floor, shadow, effects or checkerboard. Image 1 is authoritative IDENTITY only, do NOT inherit her jump or lifted knee. Image 2 is the confirmed MAIN STYLE reference: clean bright rounded Daoist chibi hand-painted material, delicate warm shading, polished fine edges. Image 3 is the current SAME CHARACTER proportion and equipment reference; retain its short limbs, large round head and same complete straight spear. Preserve exact brown double buns and long twin ponytails, red ribbons, gold and pale-turquoise hair jewelry, amber eyes, red forehead jewel, red/white/gold layered dress, gold waist beads, red-white-gold ankle boots, dark spear shaft, crimson crystal spearhead in gold mount and red tassels. Never invent armor or adult long legs. Fixed slightly elevated game camera, 2.7-head chibi proportions, complete figure and spear inside canvas with generous outer margin. Body root centered x512, ground contact y942 of 1024; keep head and equipment scale consistent with image3. Both hands firmly hold ONE straight spear: anatomical LEFT hand high near chest and closer to spearhead, anatomical RIGHT hand low near waist and closer to spear butt. Hands must rotate with body anatomically; do not swap grip. Spear is calmly diagonal, head elevated forward and butt lowered behind, no attack motion. Neutral happy closed mouth. Walking is a grounded short stride, upright torso, soft tiny counter-motion of sleeves/tails. Feet follow distinct narrow parallel anatomical tracks; no crossed legs, running, hopping, high kicks, or both feet airborne. Complete spearhead, butt tip, hair strands and sleeve edges uncut. No magenta fringe or colored matte. Facing exactly EAST, screen RIGHT in strict right-side profile. Nose and chest point right, not toward viewer. Anatomical LEFT leg is FARTHER from viewer and slightly higher in ground projection. Anatomical RIGHT leg is NEARER and slightly lower in ground projection. Travel forward is SCREEN RIGHT. Camera may see a little upper surface but no front-facing torso. PHASE 09 right heel contact: anatomical RIGHT leg reaches a short stride FORWARD, right heel touching ground and beginning weight-bearing; anatomical LEFT leg stays BEHIND on its toe, left heel lifted. Both feet contact ground briefly. Clearly RIGHT leading, LEFT trailing. This is opposite-leg contact to phase01.CRITICAL: exact 90 degree right-facing profile, ONE eye. NEAR anatomical RIGHT leg must sweep forward across/in front of far left thigh and land its heel to screen right and LOWER than rear far boot. The FAR LEFT leg is behind to screen left with heel raised, toe touching a slightly HIGHER distant ground track. Near right leg front edge overlaps far left leg. Make this right-contact pose clearly different from left-contact and passing phases. Short natural stride, torso over the gap between feet, no run.
